questions.question: What is the difference between vertebrates and invertebrates? Name the three jobs of a vertebrate skeleton.
questions.expected_answer: Vertebrates have a backbone and a skeleton of bones inside; invertebrates have no backbone and no bones inside. The skeleton supports the body and gives it shape, protects soft organs such as the brain, spinal cord, heart and lungs, and allows movement with muscles and joints.

questions.question: Explain photosynthesis and draw a food chain of three or four links in words.
questions.expected_answer: Green plants make their own food in their leaves using water, carbon dioxide and energy from sunlight, and give off oxygen. A food chain: grass, arrow, grasshopper, arrow, frog, arrow, snake. The arrows point from the food to the eater.

questions.question: Describe the life cycle of a frog or a plant, and give one way animals care for their young.
questions.expected_answer: Frog: egg, tadpole, froglet, adult frog, which lays eggs. Plant: seed, seedling, adult plant, flowers, pollination, new seeds. Animals care for young by feeding them, keeping them warm and protecting them, like penguins warming eggs or crocodiles carrying babies to water.
